Browser-only import libraries bundled into the online board and the single-file offline export:

- Papa Parse 5.7.0, `papaparse.min.js`, https://www.papaparse.com/ — MIT license in `LICENSE.papaparse`.
- read-excel-file 9.3.12, `read-excel-file.min.js`, https://gitlab.com/catamphetamine/read-excel-file — MIT license in `LICENSE.read-excel-file`.

The libraries run locally in the browser; the original imported file is not uploaded.
